Pathway and target map

This graphic depicts pathways (bold) containing Mtb targets for which inhibitors or activators exist that (i) inhibit growth of Mtb and for which (ii) multiple lines of evidence support that growth inhibition is mediated via engagement of the target listed. Targets are considered clinically validated when compounds have shown activity in an EBA (early bactericidal activity) study. Detailed information on each target in this map is provided in Supplementary Table 1
